sections.Overview: Latest Version: v1.20 NEW MODE – New retro video mode based on electromechanical games from the era of the film. Video mode starts on the third Mystery Award by default and can be played once per player, per game. FEATURE – Added Hook Multiball Quick Start. After locking the first or second ball during standard play, press the action button during the countdown to start a three ball multiball. FEATURE – Hook Multiball jackpot values now scale with the number of balls physically locked: 1X, 2X, or 3X. Lock all three balls for the highest starting values. FEATURE – Added RGB deadbar and apron lighting effects throughout the game, including mode colors, combo feedback, jackpots, and chainsaw effects. BUG FIX – Improved ball search behavior so the current search phase finishes properly after detecting a switch. Added a shooter lane eject attempt during ball search. BUG FIX – Corrected multiball and drain state cleanup when a game is aborted through the service menu. BUG FIX – Corrected mode progress indicators for modes waiting to start. BUG FIX – Corrected BBQ drop target state tracking when the target is already raised. BUG FIX – Corrected combo bar display restoration during Hitchhiker. v1.00 FEATURE – Added the new Bonus Ball. Qualify the Bonus Ball by completing combos and activating the shot multiplier with a double tap of the extra flipper button. An earned Bonus Ball will play at the conclusion of the game. Bonus Ball is a timed ball focused on completing combos and locking balls. FEATURE – Improved on-screen display of mode transitions and completions. FEATURE – Completed modes now dim instead of turning off. FEATURE – Holding the action button will activate a ball search. FEATURE – Improved code handling for text and image access to enhance performance. MENU – Entering the menu now ends the current game. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where apron lighting could remain on after certain modes. BUG FIX – Corrected display behavior for captive ball hit tracking. v0.98 FEATURE – Added new movie videos and callouts to most modes. FEATURE – Introduced an additional mode for Franklin at the inner loop. Players can now advance the story at any time when the inner loop is not lit for other events. FEATURE – Reworked the skill shot to avoid using the highest BBQ target. Added a Super Skill Shot and a Secret Skill Shot. To activate the Super Skill Shot, hold the left flipper button before launching the ball. FEATURE – Highlighted the ‘Super Shot’ multiplier, which builds through combos and activates with a double tap of the extra flipper button. New animations added. FEATURE – Implemented dead-end shots in all combo sequences. FEATURE – Updated Door Frenzy to require a mode to be played before it can restart. MENU – Added a debug screen, accessible by holding the red menu button. MENU – Introduced a switch visualizer in the test menu. MENU – Improved Tournament Mode settings. MENU – Refined magnet fling settings, reducing granularity from 20ms to 5ms. A reset of menu settings is required for this change to take effect. BUG FIX – Fixed a scoring issue in Door Frenzy. BUG FIX – Resolved an error when a ball fell backward into the door scoop during Dinner Mode. BUG FIX – Corrected an issue with Coin Audits. BUG FIX – Added a check to prevent partial messages from blocking communication between the Warden and PC. NOTE – From the public beta to this release, changes include delaying mode starts until after the Super Skill Shot, improving left scoop behavior, and simplifying missed divert handling at the Meat Grinder. v0.95 FEATURE – New Mode: The Family. FEATURE – Added a menu setting to reduce shots to qualify modes. BUG FIX – Game now displays partial credits at all times. BUG FIX – Patched a bug where the combo meter lights were not resetting at specific times. BUG FIX – Various fixes and game enhancements. v0.94.1 FEATURE – Grave Rob Mode. FEATURE – Select modes by holding Left Flipper (lower) or Right Flipper (upper) while pressing Start. FEATURE – Pressing the Action Button during Door Frenzy releases the ball on the Magnet. FEATURE – Woods Chase hurry-up shot moves more slowly. FEATURE – Added menu option to disable PWM on flipper hold. BUG FIX – Early plunging a saved ball affected ball counts. BUG FIX – Soft eject lightshow from the BBQ scoop could become stuck. BUG FIX – Failed ejects from the Door VUK could cause video lag in Door Frenzy. BUG FIX – Draining while locking a ball during Door Frenzy could skip the call to release the magnet. v0.93 Beta Code With the number of additions from v0.93 Beta Code, we included everything in v0.93 Beta Code and moved directly to v0.94. v0.92 Hook Multiball rewritten for improved stability. Fast outlane saves restored. Right outlane saves qualified by the Pam targets restored. Risky shot ball saves restored. New menu options for risky shot ball saves. Improved handling of video assets. Improved trough logic and ball tracking. v0.91 Increased max pulse time on high power flipper coils. Added max pulse time setting for high power flipper coils in Gameplay Settings. v0.90 Trough code reworked for reliability. Hook Lock code reworked for reliability. Ball eject now holds briefly to prevent jams. BUG FIX – Rapid flipping during ball eject could cause additional balls to eject. BUG FIX – Ball save was not ending when the game was reset with the Start button. BUG FIX – Hole-In-One super jackpot caused an error. BUG FIX – Cook mode with multiple balls into scoop was not recovering. v0.89 Numerous bug fixes. v0.88 Launch code.
